units.source_text: 老头疑惑地垂下眼睛，吐了口唾沫。

en.t: The old man lowered his eyes in doubt and spat.

units.source_text: 也许还是说任凭唾沫从嘴里淌出来更正确。

en.t: Or perhaps it would be more accurate to say he simply let the spit dribble from his mouth.

units.source_text: 一阵风刮来，淌下来的唾沫，丝丝拉拉地飘在嘴边。

en.t: A gust of wind came up, and the dribbling saliva trailed in thin strands around his mouth.
It was hard to tell what he was so worried about.
